dsp GenVoiceOBassClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 382.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 680.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2405.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c

dsp GenVoiceOBassBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 382.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 680.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2405.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08

dsp GenVoiceOTenorClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 450.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 800.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b

dsp GenVoiceOTenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 450.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 800.0) / sr))

dsp GenVoiceOAltoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 504.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0

    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 276.25 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 595.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2150.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2931

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 325.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2530.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3523

dsp GenVoiceUTenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 325.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2530.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3471

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0

    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))

    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 364.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 784.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2833.6) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c

    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4528

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 364.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 784.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2833.6) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4436

dsp GenVoiceUSopranoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 390.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 840.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3036.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5346

dsp GenVoiceUSopranoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 390.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 840.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3036.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5193

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 422.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 910.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3289.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5265

dsp GenVoiceUChildBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 422.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 910.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3289.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5132

dsp GenVoiceAaBassClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 552.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 918.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2252.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3664

dsp GenVoiceAaBassBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 552.5 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 918.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2252.5) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3482

dsp GenVoiceAaTenorClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 650.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1080.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2650.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2898

dsp GenVoiceAaTenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 650.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1080.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2650.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2814

  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 728.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1209.6) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2968.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3269

dsp GenVoiceAaAltoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 728.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1209.6) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2968.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3240

dsp GenVoiceAaSopranoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 780.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1296.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3180.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3774

dsp GenVoiceAaSopranoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 780.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1296.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3180.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3708

dsp GenVoiceAaChildClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 845.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1404.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3445.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4178

dsp GenVoiceAaChildBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 845.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1404.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3445.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4056

dsp GenVoiceEeBassClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 255.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1955.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2550.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2953

dsp GenVoiceEeBassBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 255.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1955.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2550.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.2938

dsp GenVoiceEeTenorClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2300.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3000.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3614

dsp GenVoiceEeTenorBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2300.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3000.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.3573

dsp GenVoiceEeAltoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 336.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2576.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3360.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4167

dsp GenVoiceEeAltoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 336.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2576.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3360.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4104

dsp GenVoiceEeSopranoClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 360.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2760.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3600.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5048

dsp GenVoiceEeSopranoBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 360.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2760.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3600.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.4926

dsp GenVoiceEeChildClean where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.04
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 390.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2990.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3900.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5539

voiceEeChildBreathy.source:
dsp GenVoiceEeChildBreathy where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state ph : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1a : F32 := 0.0
  state i2a : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b : F32 := 0.0
  state i1c : F32 := 0.0
  state i2c : F32 := 0.0
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.3 / sr)
    set ph := fract(ph + min(0.45, max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.006) / sr))
    let glottal := (ph * 2.0 - 1.0) * envA + nz * envA * 0.35
    let ga := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 390.0 * (0.9 + colour * 0.2)) / sr))
    let ka := 0.12
    let aa := 1.0 / (1.0 + ga * (ga + ka))
    let v1a := aa * (i1a + ga * (glottal - i2a))
    let v2a := i2a + ga * v1a
    set i1a := 2.0 * v1a - i1a
    set i2a := 2.0 * v2a - i2a
    let gb := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 2990.0) / sr))
    let kb := 0.1
    let ab := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb * (gb + kb))
    let v1b := ab * (i1b + gb * (glottal - i2b))
    let v2b := i2b + gb * v1b
    set i1b := 2.0 * v1b - i1b
    set i2b := 2.0 * v2b - i2b
    let gc := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 3900.0) / sr))
    let kc := 0.08
    let ac := 1.0 / (1.0 + gc * (gc + kc))
    let v1c := ac * (i1c + gc * (glottal - i2c))
    let v2c := i2c + gc * v1c
    set i1c := 2.0 * v1c - i1c
    set i2c := 2.0 * v2c - i2c
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((v1a + v1b * 0.6 + v1c * 0.3) * 0.9) * 0.5242
